description:
Minyoo Seo has accepted her fate as the school outcast. During her first year of college, a creeper latched onto her, making it impossible for her to make friends or date. Just when Minyoo thought she was going to have a dull college life, she met Woobin Seon, one of the hottest guys on campus. Woobin is kind, funny, and seems to have feelings for Minyoo. However, falling for one of the most popular guys on campus has its downfall, and Minyoo is about to find out how complicated love can be…
